question: SNDK 页面曾出现 'TSM Revenue Growth' 的问题

runs_inspected.note: real run legitimately contains a 'TSM Revenue Growth' graph node

artifact_level_findings.conclusion: Zero occurrences of the string 'TSM' in any artifact belonging to either real, on-disk SNDK run. Re-confirmed via a fresh Architecture Replay of both SNDK source runs and a full Ticker Consistency Audit: ticker_consistency=pass, inconsistencies=0, foreign_entity_findings with actual_ticker=TSM=0 for both.

node_label_mechanism.code: if factor == 'Revenue Growth' and ticker: return f'{str(ticker).upper()} Revenue Growth'
node_label_mechanism.explanation: Every ticker's own Structure Graph legitimately labels its 'Revenue Growth' factor node with that run's own ticker prefix -- confirmed on the real TSM run (1a338ced-118e-44d2-b3f6-2444bfb9d7e6), whose graph genuinely contains a node labeled 'TSM Revenue Growth' (id=tsm_revenue_growth). This is by-design, deterministic, per-run behavior, not a data quality defect -- the label 'TSM Revenue Growth' is only ever produced inside a run whose own ticker is TSM.

frontend_investigation.defect_description: useGraphAndConflicts's fetch effect correctly depended on [runId, reloadToken] and used an AbortController to cancel superseded requests (so a stale response could never overwrite newer state) -- but it never cleared `graph`/`conflicts` React state when `runId` changed. Combined with the render guard `isLoading && !graph`, switching from one run to another (e.g. a TSM run to a SNDK run) via client-side navigation continued rendering the PREVIOUS run's full Structure Graph -- including its own ticker-labeled node names such as 'TSM Revenue Growth' -- for the entire loading window of the newly-selected run.
frontend_investigation.reproduction_method: New test: 'never continues to display a previous run's graph while the newly-selected run is still loading' in frontend/src/pages/StructureGraphPage.test.tsx -- fails against the pre-fix code, passes after the fix.
frontend_investigation.fix_applied: 1) Clear graph/conflicts state immediately on runId change, before the new fetch starts. 2) Added a defensive check: if the fetched payload's own embedded run_id disagrees with the currently-selected runId, show a 'Data Integrity Warning' and refuse to render, rather than ever silently mixing runs.

verdict_explanation: A real, reproducible frontend defect (FRONTEND_STALE_CACHE) was found and fixed: switching from a TSM run to a SNDK run via client-side navigation could display the TSM run's Structure Graph -- including its 'TSM Revenue Growth' node label -- for the duration of the SNDK run's loading window. This is sufficient on its own to produce exactly the reported symptom. ARTIFACT_TICKER_MISMATCH and FOREIGN_TICKER_EVIDENCE_CONTAMINATION are explicitly RULED OUT: both real, on-disk SNDK runs (183b04dd-..., 8d21c047-...) were re-verified via a fresh Architecture Replay plus the full Ticker Consistency Audit and contain zero TSM-related artifact contamination. Separately, LEGITIMATE_PEER_COMPARISON is confirmed as the mechanism if 'TSM Revenue Growth' was instead seen while genuinely viewing the real TSM run (1a338ced-...) -- that run's own graph correctly and legitimately contains that node.
not_applicable: SCREENSHOT_OR_LABEL_MISUNDERSTANDING (cannot be confirmed or excluded without the original screenshot/session; not required given a real code-level cause was found and fixed)
